verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform. Multi-session terminal management with per-session context, appearance and history is a terminal-emulator capability, outside its product category. The evidence covers only Tailscale SSH authentication and authorization of SSH connections, not a terminal client with tabs, themes or history, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history
